en: This vintage postcard features a richly decorated, heraldic front with a portrait of a royal woman, likely Princess Marie Louise of Bulgaria, encircled in an ornate gold frame. The design includes military symbols (crossed rifles, flags featuring the Bulgarian tricolor, a lion, swords, and drums), banners with Cyrillic text, and emblems. The back has a blue-green background with armor, flags, and spears, as well as Cyrillic text declaring the card's purpose and origin. The overall aesthetic suggests a nationalistic and royal commemoration.
